purpose: Permanent record of operational defects affecting canonical state. INFORMATIONAL ONLY - must never participate in trading logic.

incidents.title: CANONICAL_CLASSIFICATION_MUTATION_BY_POST_DEADLINE_AUDIT
root_cause: audit() was non-idempotent: a later diagnostic run replaced an already-settled canonical classification using its own trigger_role, which has no signal authority.
Timing attribution selected the most recent SIGNAL_JOB_STARTED rather than the one belonging to the role that created the durable canonical lock, producing a false 464.7-minute lateness.
incidents.impact: Observation #1 (2026-09-13) was silently downgraded from CANONICAL_AUTOMATIC_ON_TIME to POST_HOC_RECONSTRUCTION with counts_as_prospective_observation set false. The prospective sample under-reported by one. No signal artifact, execution, ledger entry or capital value was altered.
incidents.detection_mechanism: Disagreement between the independently derived canonical prospective count and the expected canonical observation history. The derived count read 1 where 2 was expected. A manually maintained counter would have agreed with itself and concealed the defect.
corrective_patch: Canonical automatic classifications are immutable: no later run may downgrade a settled CANONICAL_AUTOMATIC_* observation. Re-audits are recorded as metadata only.
lock_creating_start() attributes timing to the run that durably persisted the lock.

CANONICAL_INTEGRITY_INCIDENT path: immutability does not conceal a genuine contradiction (absent artifact, unauthorised lock creator, lock after the activation deadline). Automatic mutation stops and explicit review is required.
incidents.regression_test: Reproduces the exact sequence: PRIMARY_EXTERNAL creates a valid canonical lock, a later POST_DEADLINE_AUDIT targets the same execution date, classification and prospective flag remain unchanged, later run recorded only as re-audit metadata.
incidents.historical_remediation: CANONICAL_METADATA_CORRECTION, append-only. Corrupted values preserved in the log's corrections[] array rather than erased. No trade, execution, ledger entry or capital change created.
incidents.architectural_lesson: An observability component with unrestricted write authority over the artifacts it audits can destroy the records it exists to verify. The prohibition in force forbade promoting a reconstruction to canonical; nothing forbade the reverse, because that direction had not been anticipated. Recorded for future design; no redesign undertaken during the reliability window.
